_what: CK component -> LIVE selector bindings. Raw material for a CK ui-state prover, NOT a finished table: only `bound` may be walked, and each entry carries the sample text it was confirmed by.
_method: Source-line parsing was tried FIRST and rejected: 26 of 66 derived, and the derivations were unsafe (a template-literal fragment `.reaction-btn${d.mine`; `#dp-week-hero` bound to a component named 'item modal'). A line number says where a component was WRITTEN, not what it renders.

So candidates come from a LIVE inventory of all 22 pages (tools/ground_components.mjs): 228 repeated structures + 483 id-blocks, ranked by MEANING rather than by count, because ranking by count on a utility-CSS page returns `.flex.items-center` and never the component.

Name-token matching then proposed 30 bindings. THREE filters cut that to 11, each filter added because it caught a real error: a BUTTON is not the component it opens (`#asset-picker-btn` for 'parts picker'); a row/tile/card must REPEAT, not be a singleton id; and a row that renders under 20 characters is a label INSIDE the row, not the row (`.badge` -> 'BEARINGS' for 'part row').
The 36 that never matched and the 19 rejected are NOT guesses to be filled in later from this file - they need a live look, page by page, the way tools/dialog_targets.mjs was built.

All proposals were then CONFIRMED LIVE (every selector queried on its own page). 11 resolved; 2 of those were still wrong on inspection of their sample text and were dropped. 9 stand, each with the text it renders. Resolving is necessary and not sufficient — a selector can match a real node that is the wrong component.
